Resolves #21693

🌿 *A zoom can no longer drop a planner on a date they never scrolled to.*

`Neo.scheduler.Container#zoomTo` now keeps the date at the visible timeline's left edge: it reads that date before the scale changes and brings it back to the edge afterwards through the new public `scrollToDate(date)`, which scrolls once the horizontal scrollbar carries the new width. While the timeline's start is in view nothing scrolls, so an unscrolled plan still opens on its first day at every level. `zoomTo` keeps returning the axis synchronously, and the Gantt inherits the behaviour through `super.zoomTo`.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on `examples/scheduler/bigData`, red on `dev`, green at head) → L3 required (AC-1 and AC-2 are browser observations). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 left edge kept both ways | CI: `test/playwright/e2e/scheduler/ZoomAnchor.spec.mjs`, "a zoom keeps the date at the timeline's left edge, both ways" (Week → Day → Week, within one Week pixel) |
| AC-2 unscrolled plans stay at 0 | CI: same spec, "a zoom scrolls nothing while the timeline's start is in view" |
| AC-3 red on `dev`, Gantt zoom specs green | Outside CI: Test Evidence below (the red-on-base job runs unit specs only). CI: `e2e/gantt` (`ZoomNL`, `BasicNL`, `CascadeTransitionNL`) and `unit/gantt/CascadeMotion.spec.mjs` |
| AC-4 `zoomTo` returns the axis synchronously | CI: `Neo.gantt.Container#zoomTo` reads it on every zoom in `e2e/gantt` and in `CascadeMotion.spec.mjs`'s zoom row |

## Deltas from ticket
- The scroll helper is a public `scrollToDate(date)` rather than a protected pixel helper: the zoom's scroll is exactly "this date back at the left edge", and #21617's example opens at Monday 08:00 through the same route. Ticket body and ledger updated.

## Commits
- `80fb74bc3e` — the anchor in `zoomTo` and the spec
- `be69448eba` — `scrollToDate(date)` replaces the protected pixel helper

## Test Evidence
- `ZoomAnchor.spec.mjs` with `src/scheduler/Container.mjs` reverted to `dev`: the first test fails with `the region scrolled with the scale` (Week at 20,000 px → Day still at 20,000 px), the second passes. At head: 2/2.
- The spec measures the edge from the DOM (the region's `scrollLeft` less where the timeline header starts in the region's content), not from `zoomTo`'s own arithmetic. That matters here: `bigData` scrolls a 128 px "Team · Site" column before the timeline, and a probe that ignored it was off by exactly that column.
- Local at head: `e2e/scheduler` + `e2e/gantt` 40 passed; `unit/scheduler`, `unit/gantt`, `unit/timeline` 125 passed; `unit/grid/HeaderGridSubclass.spec.mjs` 4 passed.
